steps.text: These are ideographic telegraph symbols for consecutive days of the month: day 20 (㏳), day 21 (㏴), day 22 (㏵). The next glyph is ㏶ (IDEOGRAPHIC TELEGRAPH SYMBOL FOR DAY TWENTY-THREE, U+33F6).
